T: Shiver me timbers. Pass the stew.
D: Young Jim Hawkins and his Muppet friends sail off with a treasure map and a ship's cook named Long John Silver.
P: Serve the main when Long John Silver cooks in the ship's galley.
S: the Admiral Benbow Inn where Jim works
Little sausages glazed in honey and mustard, the kind of pub grub served at a seaside inn.
Hard crackers with cheese and pickled onions, sea rations for the long voyage. Arrange 200g water crackers, 200g cheddar and a bowl of pickled onions on a board.
M: Long John Silver, the ship's cook
A hearty fish and potato stew from the galley, the one thing Silver is honestly good at.
W: Chocolate brownies piled with gold-wrapped chocolate coins, a chest of buried treasure. Bake brownies from 200g dark chocolate, 180g butter, 300g sugar, 3 eggs and 100g flour at 170C for 28 minutes.
K: Ginger beer with lime, rum on the side for the adults.

s.note: the Admiral Benbow Inn where Jim works
s.how: Bake 500g cocktail sausages at 200C for 15 minutes. Toss in 2 tbsp honey and 1 tbsp wholegrain mustard and bake 5 more minutes until sticky.
Arrange 200g water crackers, 200g cheddar and a bowl of pickled onions on a board. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.

m.note: Long John Silver, the ship's cook
m.how: Soften an onion and 2 celery stalks in butter. Add 500g diced potatoes and 750ml fish stock and simmer 15 minutes. Add 600g white fish chunks and 200ml cream and cook 5 minutes.

w.how: Bake brownies from 200g dark chocolate, 180g butter, 300g sugar, 3 eggs and 100g flour at 170C for 28 minutes. Pile gold chocolate coins on top.

d.how: Pour 1.25L ginger beer over ice with lime wedges. Have 120ml dark rum on the side for adults. Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold.
